purpose: Infra and web for removing an APD campaign learning path: gateway delete (courses via FK cascade), removal use case, thin destroy action and DELETE route, destroy_url per learning path, red Hapus button with confirmation dialog on the campaign edit page. Includes the merged PR 2c domain.
acceptance_criteria: Only admins can remove a campaign learning path
The learning path must belong to the campaign, otherwise not found
A learning path that already has students cannot be removed
Removing deletes the learning path with its courses and logs CampaignLearningPathWasRemoved

reviews.evidence: Claude Code pr-rules subagent (background run launched after 2026-11-24T11:13:40+07:00); reviewed diff artifact for all non-generated changed paths incl. merged PR 2c domain files, plus CampaignLearningPathUpdateSpecification/Action siblings, gateway findLearningPath/hasStudents, access_lists learning_path_id migration; findings: 1 question (2d-Q1)

Claude Code pr-simplicity subagent (background run launched after 2026-11-24T11:13:40+07:00); reviewed diff artifact for all non-generated changed paths plus the learning path courses migration (cascade); findings: none

findings.evidence: hasStudents counts only STUDENT access_lists rows while the access_lists.learning_path_id FK is RESTRICT for every role; a non-STUDENT row with learning_path_id would bypass ALREADY_HAS_STUDENTS and fail with a generic error
findings.resolution: Only STUDENT rows can carry learning_path_id: ParticipantCreation (4c) and ParticipantEnrollment (4a) build Participant with role STUDENT, ParticipantImport (4d) creates STUDENT only and rejects rows registered with another role (REGISTERED_WITH_OTHER_ROLE), ContributorCreation sets learningPathId null, and the backfill filters role STUDENT. Local data: all 21 rows with learning_path_id are STUDENT. No code change. Dismissed by author krisnasantosa15 on 2026-11-24 ("oke tutup").
